title: Report email verification before terms acceptance in dashboard and console onboarding

endpoints.before: During an active rollout, signed-in dashboard console requests with unverified email and no terms acceptance returned 403 AGREEMENT_REQUIRED. Dashboard gates also advertised terms before verification.
endpoints.after: Dashboard console requests return 403 EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED until email is verified, then 403 AGREEMENT_REQUIRED until the current terms edition is accepted. Dashboard gates list required terms only after verification. Public API-key access, anonymous access, eligibility, quotas and successful responses are unchanged.
endpoints.clientAction: Console clients should handle EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED by verifying the notification email first, then handle AGREEMENT_REQUIRED by accepting the current terms. Existing application API-key integrations require no change.
